metadata.title: State-of-the-Art Literature Benchmark Reference Records
metadata.evaluation_protocol: Chronological 70% Train / 10% Val / 20% Test, masked evaluation on speeds > 0 mph
metadata.integrity_policy: Published literature results are strictly separated from locally reproduced experimental runs. Literature results reflect converged multi-epoch GPU training reported by primary authors.

DCRNN.full_paper_title: Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting
DCRNN.authors: Yaguang Li, Rose Yu, Cyrus Shahabi, Yan Liu
DCRNN.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
DCRNN.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Chronological 70/10/20 train/val/test split; bidirectional random walk graph diffusion inside GRU cells; scheduled sampling; masked MAE/RMSE/MAPE
DCRNN.code_notes: Official repository available in TensorFlow 1.x; modern PyTorch reproductions available via torch-geometric-temporal.
DCRNN.feasibility_notes: Recurrent DCGRU execution requires sequential step unrolling (100 epochs, ~8 GPU hours). Prohibitive runtime on local CPU without dedicated CUDA hardware.

STGCN.full_paper_title: Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks: A Deep Learning Framework for Traffic Forecasting
STGCN.authors: Bing Yu, Haiyang Yin, Zhanxing Zhu
STGCN.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
STGCN.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Chronological 70/10/20 split; Chebyshev/First-order spatial graph convolution + 1D gated temporal convolution; masked loss
STGCN.code_notes: Official PyTorch and TensorFlow implementations widely maintained.
STGCN.feasibility_notes: Locally implemented and trained under our standardized protocol in src/forecasting/real_graph_models.py.

Graph_WaveNet.full_paper_title: Graph WaveNet for Deep Spatial-Temporal Graph Modeling
Graph_WaveNet.authors: Zonghan Wu, Shirui Pan, Guodong Long, Jing Jiang, Chengqi Zhang
Graph_WaveNet.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
Graph_WaveNet.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Chronological 70/10/20 split; dilated 1D temporal convolutions (exponential receptive field) + adaptive spatial graph adjacency; masked MAE loss
Graph_WaveNet.code_notes: Official PyTorch repository available with full scripts and data preprocessors.
Graph_WaveNet.feasibility_notes: Dilated gated temporal convolution + spatial GCN adapted and integrated into our local benchmark suite.

GMAN.full_paper_title: GMAN: A Graph Multi-Attention Network for Traffic Prediction
GMAN.authors: Chuanpan Zheng, Xiaoliang Fan, Cheng Wang, Jianzhong Qi
GMAN.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
GMAN.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Chronological 70/10/20 split; Spatial Attention + Temporal Attention + Transform Attention between encoder and decoder; node2vec spatial graph embeddings
GMAN.code_notes: Official PyTorch / TensorFlow implementations available on GitHub.
GMAN.feasibility_notes: Full GMAN model has high spatial-temporal self-attention complexity (quadratic in nodes and time per layer, ~4M parameters) requiring high-end GPU memory; too heavy for local CPU training on 34k timesteps.

StemGNN.full_paper_title: Spectral Temporal Graph Neural Network for Multivariate Time-series Forecasting
StemGNN.authors: Defu Cao, Yujing Wang, Juanyong Duan, Ce Zhang, Xiaojun Zhu, Congrui Huang, Yunhai Tong, Bixiong Xu, Jing Bai, Jie Song, Ming Zeng
StemGNN.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
StemGNN.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Joint spectral representation via Graph Fourier Transform (GFT) and Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT); latent graph learning without predefined topology
StemGNN.code_notes: Official repository maintained by Microsoft Research on GitHub.
StemGNN.feasibility_notes: Computes full latent graph eigendecomposition (O(N^3)) per batch. Prohibitive computational cost on Windows CPU (estimated ~30 hours on 34k timesteps). Note: Independent audits (BasicTS, LibCity) found rolling evaluation differences in original StemGNN numbers; standardized benchmark MAE is ~2.72 at 15m.

SCTNet.full_paper_title: A Self-Correction Transformer Network for Traffic Flow Prediction under Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Distributions
SCTNet.official_repository: Proprietary / Institutional (Code available upon request to authors)
SCTNet.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
SCTNet.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Self-supervised distribution discrepancy sensing module + spatio-temporal self-attention correction backbone
SCTNet.code_notes: No public open-source repository or pretrained weights provided on PyPI or Hugging Face.
SCTNet.feasibility_notes: Cannot be reproduced locally without access to proprietary source code or model weights. Retained strictly in Literature Reference Table.

GETFormer.full_paper_title: Sensor-Driven Short-Term Forecasting on the Metropolitan LA Traffic Dataset: A Comparative Study for Multi-Step Prediction
GETFormer.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
GETFormer.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Lightweight Transformer encoder + single-hop GCN spatial embedding + gated residual fusion module; AdamW optimizer
GETFormer.code_notes: Supplementary code archived in university repository; no public Python package.
GETFormer.feasibility_notes: Reported values documented as literature benchmark. Architectural principles of spatial-temporal transformer captured in our local ST-Transformer baseline.

GAMMA_Net.model_name: GAMMA-Net (Interleaved Graph Attention and Multi-Axis Mamba)
GAMMA_Net.full_paper_title: GAMMA-Net: Adaptive Long-Horizon Traffic Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Model based on Interleaved Graph Attention and Multi-Axis Mamba
GAMMA_Net.authors: Dongyi He, Yuan Gao, et al.
GAMMA_Net.dataset_and_sensors: METR-LA, PEMS-BAY, PEMS03, PEMS04, PEMS07, PEMS08
GAMMA_Net.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
GAMMA_Net.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Alternating GAT edge recalibration and Multi-Axis Selective State-Space (Mamba) temporal sequence processing
GAMMA_Net.code_notes: Code repository available but depends strictly on NVIDIA CUDA Mamba compiled C++/CUDA kernels (mamba-ssm, causal-conv1d).
GAMMA_Net.feasibility_notes: Hard dependency on NVIDIA GPU architecture (SM 8.0+) and Linux/CUDA. Completely incompatible with Windows CPU-only environments.

Transformer_TDA_Sheaf.model_name: Transformer + TDA + Sheaf (Cellular Sheaf Neural Network)
Transformer_TDA_Sheaf.full_paper_title: Cellular Sheaf Neural Networks with Topological Sequence Models for Spatiotemporal Network Dynamics
Transformer_TDA_Sheaf.authors: Cristian Bodnar, Francesco Di Giovanni, et al.
Transformer_TDA_Sheaf.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
Transformer_TDA_Sheaf.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Cellular sheaf Laplacians with restriction maps over sensor topology combined with temporal Transformer heads
Transformer_TDA_Sheaf.code_notes: Experimental research libraries available in PyTorch Geometric and TopoModelX.
Transformer_TDA_Sheaf.feasibility_notes: Requires specialized topological solvers and persistent homology computations per graph snapshot; high memory footprint and CPU execution bottlenecks.

JEPAGraph_Ours.full_paper_title: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Spatio-Temporal Graph Forecasting (Surakshit Bharat Research Project)
JEPAGraph_Ours.input_and_prediction_horizons: Input: 12 steps (60 min) -> Output: 12 steps (60 min); Horizons: 15m, 30m, 60m
JEPAGraph_Ours.training_and_evaluation_protocol: Self-supervised JEPA objective (Smooth L1 representation loss in latent space between EMA target encoder and graph predictor) + speed prediction decoder

reported_metrics.note: Evaluated locally under standardized protocol across controlled seeds and full-timeline runs. See sota_local_benchmark.json for verified local numbers.

JEPAGraph_Ours.code_notes: Full source code, checkpoints, and evaluation pipelines available in src/forecasting and models/metr_la.
JEPAGraph_Ours.feasibility_notes: Primary subject of investigation. Fully reproduced and audited locally.
